# Ninja Adventure asset pack (CC0)

Art by **Pixel-boy**, published by Sparklin Labs for Superpowers under
**CC0 1.0 Universal** (public domain dedication, see LICENSE.txt).

Source: https://github.com/sparklinlabs/superpowers-asset-packs (folder `ninja-adventure`)
Original pack page: https://pixel-boy.itch.io/ninja-adventure-asset-pack

Only the files used by Beacon Isle are copied here. Music and sound effects
from the same pack were converted to MP3 into `client/public/assets/audio/`.
Crediting is not required by CC0, but we credit the author gladly.
